Workspace

Contact and report a problem

Get support, report a calculation or data problem, and ask privacy questions.

The current support channel is the project’s public GitHub issue tracker. You can read existing reports without a site login; GitHub may require an account to post a new issue.

Report a data or interface problem

Include the contract symbol, selected horizon, approximate time and timezone, browser, the page you were using, and what you expected to happen. A screenshot with private information removed can help. A public-data example is enough; you do not need to connect an exchange account.

Keep private information out of public issues

Do not post exchange API keys, passwords, wallet recovery phrases, payment information, account balances, or personal identifying documents. Public issues can be read by anyone. The app never needs those details for support.

Privacy and advertising questions

Read the Privacy notice and use Privacy choices in the footer to change optional usage measurement. You can also open a public issue with a general question or request a private contact channel without posting the sensitive details themselves.

Response expectations

This is a maintained software project, not an exchange help desk or emergency trading service. Response times are not guaranteed. For a live exchange position or account problem, use that exchange’s official support channel.
